daily_checkin.note: Custom single-item questions for daily tracking; not a validated instrument.

questions.prompt: Overall, how do you feel today?
How is your energy level today?
How stressed do you feel today?
How are your relations with the crew?
What time did you go to bed last night?
What time did you wake up this morning?
How would you rate the quality of your sleep?
Do you have any of the following today?

weekly_assessment.privacy_note: Your answers stay with you by default. They are not used by the anomaly model, the language model or the alert system.
weekly_assessment.share_label: Share this assessment with the crew medical officer
weekly_assessment.support_note: Your latest weekly assessment suggests it may help to talk with the psychological support team. This is a screening result, not a diagnosis.

scales.name: WHO-5
scales.instructions: Please indicate for each of the five statements which is closest to how you have been feeling over the last two weeks. Notice that higher numbers mean better well-being.

options.label: More than half of the time
Less than half of the time

items.text: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

scales.source: World Health Organization. The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index (WHO-5). Geneva: World Health Organization; 2024 (WHO/UCN/MSD/MHE/2024.1). License: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO.

scales.name: PHQ-2
scales.instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

items.text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

scales.name: GAD-2
scales.instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

items.text: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
